oracle.inputSemantics: Exact binary64 engine inputs converted directly from Python float to mp.mpf; confidence levels use intended exact decimal table labels.

grid.construction: x = integer / 1000, integer -4000 through 4000; mean=0, standardDeviation=1

locationScaleCases.construction: Binary64 x=mean+targetZ*scale; oracle uses actual exact input floats, including input rounding.

sampleSizeWitnesses.construction: For each confidence level, choose binary64 margin from high-precision midpoint of the squares of inherited table critical value and ideal inverse-normal value, scaled by p(1-p)/targetInteger. Evaluate immutable v1 and ideal formula on the identical actual binary64 margin.

limits: Finite grid and selected transformations do not prove continuous-domain maxima or error bounds.
Sample size is the immutable table-based ceiling; it need not be the ceiling of an ideal inverse-normal quantile formula.
No source changes, full suite, production, certification or canonical counts.
